content.text:
The campaign is finished and submitted. The best composition I measured is **index 8 (Pb 0.52 / Sb 0.48), with an EQE of 0.026%**. That is still a very small photoresponse.

I had only 3 merit measurements and used all of them:

| Index | Pb : Sb | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.69 : 0.31 | −0.002 |
| **8** | **0.52 : 0.48** | **0.026** |
| 12 | 0.37 : 0.63 | 0.001 |

- **Why I started at index 8:** it sits close to the 1:1 compound Pb₂Sb₂O₇. As far as I know, its band gap is about 2.5 eV, so it should absorb the 3.2 eV illumination.
- **What the other two showed:** the Pb-rich side (index 3) gave essentially nothing. The Sb-rich side (index 12, heading toward PbSb₂O₆) was far below index 8.
- **What's uncertain:** with only 3 points out of 29 candidates, I can't say where the peak really is. It is probably near a 1:1 ratio, but compositions between indices 8 and 12 (Pb about 0.40–0.48) were never measured. Index 8 is the best I actually found, not a confirmed library maximum.
- **XRD not used:** I didn't spend any of the 5 XRD measurements. The link to Pb₂Sb₂O₇ comes from the composition and the known phase list, not from confirming which crystal phase is actually in the film.
